title: S016 2.2.4.2.1 Proof of Possession Using a Challenge from the TLS Session
parent_path: S016 2.2.4.2.1 Proof of Possession Using a Challenge from the TLS Session

statements.subject: message
statements.description: For this option, the Authentication Data inside the Client's CONNECT packet MUST contain the two-byte integer token length, the token, and the keyed message digest (MAC) or the Client signature (as shown in Figure 3).
statements.trigger: Client sends CONNECT with PoP TLS-exporter option
actions: Include two-byte integer token length in Authentication Data field of CONNECT
Include token in Authentication Data field of CONNECT
Include keyed message digest (MAC) or Client signature over TLS exporter content in Authentication Data field of CONNECT
